human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Implement deterministic aggregate queries over stored projections/signals for a selected time window: run counts/outcomes, validation health, scope health, average iterations, fallback rate, and governance intervention counts. Metrics must be explicitly named observed execution metrics. Dependency: 8018.add-run-report-api.
human_pressure.why_now: The Dashboard should answer whether governed executions are healthy without rescanning raw evidence on every request.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

machine_core.goal: Add source-neutral fleet overview aggregation over derived projection tables.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Depends on: 8018.add-run-report-api. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Metrics can drill down to contributing run IDs.
contracts: Every aggregate metric has a documented numerator/denominator.
failure_semantics: Insufficient data yields empty/unknown metrics, not success.

steps.title: Define overview DTO
details: time window, total runs, outcomes, validation states, scope states, fallback counts/rate, signal counts.

steps.title: Aggregate projections
details: Filter by created/started time and optional source.

steps.title: Compute observed runtime reliability metrics
details: Fallback/error counts only from observed evidence.
Do not call them model quality.

acceptance: Fallback rate is labeled observed runtime behavior.
No composite governance score is produced.
validate: python -m ruff check src/ailuros/analytics.py src/ailuros/storage/sqlite_storage.py tests/test_fleet_analytics.py

must_check: Unknowns are not removed from denominators without explicit metric semantics.
reject_if: Fallback rate is labeled model quality.
Raw event parser is duplicated in analytics.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
